posts.en:
dsh-rules-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6b0661991977fdee72ba.html
